Dear Sir/Madam,
The CNES hereby informs you that the activity detailed hereafter will be subject to a European tendering action process with information on ESA-STAR in the coming months: the supply and installation of two removable chillers (1 MW cold) in an insulated shelter (dimension : 40), with its dry-coolers and with all hydronic and electrical adaptations. One chiller will be installed at EPCUS1 and the other at EPCUS5. For information, the EPCU S1 and EPCU S5 are the Payload Preparation Facilities at the Guiana Space Centre (CSG) in French Guiana (see https://centrespatialguyanais.cnes.fr/en/preparation-des-satellites-en).
Furthermore, the chosen contractor will provide all the testing and commissioning support needed in order to qualify the devices for the CSG HVAC system.
